assessment: The authors present a software tool combining and correlating the documentation of intraoperative neurophysiological findings with atlas and imaging data. They also show an exemplary validation of their tool in a clinical series of 52 Parkinson's disease patients who underwent DBS surgery. This article will be of interest to clinicians and researchers who are involved in both the placement and controlling of the accuracy of the location of deep brain stimulation electrodes.
